examples.description: Record an obligation toward a matched partner

failure_modes.recovery: The error carries clarification: CLARIFICATION_NEEDED plus recovery[] steps — ask the payee principal to enable Cross-Tenant Settlement under Network → Consent.
failure_modes.when: the payee tenant has not granted cross_tenant_settlement consent (or claims narrow this call out), or either side is not KYB-approved

failure_modes.recovery: amount_cents: positive = obligation, negative = refund/reversal record; zero is meaningless.
failure_modes.when: amount_cents is not a nonzero integer, currency is missing, or to_tenant_id is your own tenant

preconditions: Records an obligation — NO money moves in this wave (the state machine is the v3 settlement-rails substrate).
You are the PAYER: payer_tenant_id is injected from your verified context and cannot be spoofed.

description: Record a payment obligation against a KYB-verified partner tenant's settlement_proposals — the record-don't-move on-ramp: this writes the row only, no money moves until a later settlement-rails door executes it. amount_cents is a nonzero integer CENTS (positive = you owe them, negative = a refund/reversal record) and currency must be a 3-letter code. Requires the payee's cross_tenant_settlement consent grant and both sides KYB-approved; payee-side failures refuse identically to block probing, but your OWN unapproved KYB answers distinctly. Your tenant is injected as payer_tenant_id and cannot be spoofed. NEXT: settlement_proposal_accept moves it to accepted on the payee side.

to_tenant_id.description: The payee tenant id — must be another tenant, never your own. The payee must hold an active cross_tenant_settlement consent grant and both tenants must be KYB-approved, or the door refuses uniformly without revealing which condition failed.

name: settlement_proposal_propose_cross_tenant
